title: National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2027

errors.claim: Section 128 authorizes incremental funding for ship-to-shore connector construction.
errors.problem: Conflates two different sections and misstates the authority. Section 128 concerns a Guided Missile Destroyer (DDG), not the ship-to-shore connector. The ship-to-shore connector is Section 129, and that authority is 'advance procurement of components,' not 'incremental funding for construction.' Both the section number and the nature of the authority are wrong.
errors.sourceTruth: SEC. 128. AUTHORITY TO USE INCREMENTAL FUNDING FOR THE CONSTRUCTION OF A GUIDED MISSILE DESTROYER (DDG). ... to enter into an incrementally funded contract for the construction of one Guided Missile Destroyer (DDG). / SEC. 129. AUTHORITY FOR ADVANCE PROCUREMENT OF COMPONENTS FOR SHIP-TO-SHORE CONNECTOR CLASS CRAFT. ... the advance procurement of components for Ship-to-Shore Connector class craft

errors.claim: Section 706 requires TRICARE to cover a supply of up to 365 days of a contraceptive ... starting no later than 180 days after enactment
errors.problem: Timing qualifier is inverted. Source says coverage begins 'not less than 180 days after' enactment (a floor: no earlier than 180 days out), whereas the analysis says 'no later than 180 days after' (a ceiling/deadline: within 180 days). Opposite direction.
errors.sourceTruth: Beginning not less than 180 days after the date of the enactment of the Act, contraceptive supplies of up to 365 days shall be covered
